mapper.sql: ID, JOB_ID, USER_NAME, ATTENDANCE_MONTH, OVERTIME_HOURS, FORGET_CLOCK_IN_NUMBER, BELATE_NUMBER, LEAVE_EARLY_NUMBER, ABSENT_NUMBER, LEAVE_NUMBER, EXEMPTION_NUMBER, REQUIRED_ATTENDANCE_DAYS, ACTUAL_ATTENDANCE_DAYS, WHETHER_UPDATE, FIFTH_WORKING_DATE, CREATED_TIME, CREATED_BY
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM PPM_KQ_INFO
order by CREATED_TIME desc

SELECT
FROM PPM_KQ_INFO WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND USER_NAME = #{userName} AND ATTENDANCE_MONTH = #{attendanceMonth}

SELECT KI.ID, KI.JOB_ID, KI.USER_NAME, KI.ATTENDANCE_MONTH, KI.OVERTIME_HOURS, KI.EXCEPTION_NUMBER, KI.FORGET_CLOCK_IN_NUMBER, KI.BELATE_NUMBER, KI.LEAVE_EARLY_NUMBER, KI.ABSENT_NUMBER, KI.LEAVE_NUMBER, KI.EXEMPTION_NUMBER, KI.REQUIRED_ATTENDANCE_DAYS, KI.ACTUAL_ATTENDANCE_DAYS, KI.WHETHER_UPDATE, KI.FIFTH_WORKING_DATE, KI.CREATED_TIME, KI.CREATED_BY, OB.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, OB.OUTSOURCE_NO SUPPLIER_ID, OI.OUTSOURCNAME SUPPLIER_NAME, OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE PM_ID, CE.EMPNAME PM_NAME, OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE, E4.DICTNAME OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME, OB.CERTIFICATE_NUMBER, OB.STATE, E5.DICTNAME STATENAME, OB.ENTRY_TIME, OB.LEAVING_TIME, DECODE(OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE,'0',BS.NAME,PSI.NAME) SYSTEMPROJECTNAME, BS.NAME PROJECTNAME, VA.ANNUAL_VACATION_DATE, CASE WHEN VA.ANNUAL_VACATION_SURPLUS IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VA.ANNUAL_VACATION_SURPLUS END ANNUAL_VACATION_SURPLUS, CASE WHEN VA.ANNUAL_VACATION_DAYS IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE VA.ANNUAL_VACATION_DAYS END ANNUAL_VACATION_DAYS, PSI.NAME AS SYSTEMNAMES FROM PPM_KQ_INFO KI LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC OB ON KI.JOB_ID = OB.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO OI ON OB.OUTSOURCE_NO = OI.ORGCODE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OB.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY E4 ON OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE = E4.DICTID AND E4.DICTTYPEID = 'BUSI_OUTSOURCE_OUTSOURCETYPE' LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY E5 ON OB.STATE=E5.DICTID AND E5.DICTTYPEID='NEWKG_RYZT' LEFT JOIN PPM_PROJECT_INFO BS ON BS.ID = OB.PROJECT_NUMBER LEFT JOIN PPM_SYSTEM_INFO PSI ON PSI.ID = OB.SYSTEM_NO LEFT JOIN PPM_KQ_ANNUAL_VACATION VA ON VA.JOB_ID = KI.JOB_ID WHERE KI.ID = #{id}

SELECT KI.ID, KI.JOB_ID, KI.USER_NAME, KI.ATTENDANCE_MONTH, KI.OVERTIME_HOURS, KI.FORGET_CLOCK_IN_NUMBER, KI.BELATE_NUMBER, KI.LEAVE_EARLY_NUMBER, KI.ABSENT_NUMBER, KI.LEAVE_NUMBER, KI.EXEMPTION_NUMBER, KI.REQUIRED_ATTENDANCE_DAYS, KI.ACTUAL_ATTENDANCE_DAYS, KI.WHETHER_UPDATE, KI.FIFTH_WORKING_DATE, KI.CREATED_TIME, KI.CREATED_BY, OB.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, OB.OUTSOURCE_NO SUPPLIER_ID, OI.OUTSOURCNAME SUPPLIER_NAME, OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE PM_ID, CE.EMPNAME PM_NAME, OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE, E4.DICTNAME OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME, OB.CERTIFICATE_NUMBER, OB.STATE, DECODE(OB.STATE,'0','在岗','离岗') STATENAME, OB.ENTRY_TIME, OB.LEAVING_TIME, DECODE(OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE,'0',BS.NAME,PSI.NAME) SYSTEMPROJECTNAME, BS.NAME PROJECTNAME, PSI.NAME AS SYSTEMNAMES FROM PPM_KQ_INFO KI LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC OB ON KI.JOB_ID = OB.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO OI ON OB.OUTSOURCE_NO = OI.ORGCODE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OB.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY E4 ON OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE = E4.DICTID AND E4.DICTTYPEID = 'BUSI_OUTSOURCE_OUTSOURCETYPE' LEFT JOIN PPM_PROJECT_INFO BS ON BS.ID = OB.PROJECT_NUMBER LEFT JOIN PPM_SYSTEM_INFO PSI ON PSI.ID = OB.SYSTEM_NO
KI.JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND KI.ATTENDANCE_MONTH >= #{startDate} AND KI.ATTENDANCE_MONTH <= #{endDate} AND KI.USER_NAME like '%'||#{userName}||'%' AND OB.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND OB.DEPT_ID = #{deptValue} AND OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = #{pmId} AND OB.OUTSOURCE_NO = #{supplierId} AND OB.STATE = #{state} AND OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE = #{outsourceType} AND (OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = #{pmValue} OR CE.EMPNAME = #{pmValue}) AND
ORDER BY KI.ID DESC

SELECT KR.JOB_ID, KR.USER_NAME, KR.ATTENDANCE_DATE, KR.WORKING_TIME, KR.CLOSING_TIME, KR.OVERTIME_START_TIME, KR.IS_HOLIDAY, TO_CHAR(ROUND(KR.OVERTIME_HOURS / 60 , 2),'90.00') AS OVERTIME_MINUTE, KR.AM_WHETHER_ABNORMAL, KR.AM_ABNORMAL_REASON, KR.AM_REMARK, KR.PM_WHETHER_ABNORMAL, KR.PM_ABNORMAL_REASON, KR.PM_REMARK, KR.WHETHER_OVERNIGHT, OB.DEPT_ID, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE PM_ID, CE.EMPNAME PM_NAME, E4.DICTNAME OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME, OI.OUTSOURCNAME SUPPLIER_NAME FROM PPM_KQ_RECORD KR LEFT JOIN PPM_KQ_INFO KI ON KI.ID = KR.INFO_ID LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC OB ON KI.JOB_ID = OB.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OB.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO OI ON OB.OUTSOURCE_NO = OI.ORGCODE LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY E4 ON KR.OUTSOURCE_TYPE = E4.DICTID AND E4.DICTTYPEID = 'BUSI_OUTSOURCE_OUTSOURCETYPE'
KI.JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND KI.ATTENDANCE_MONTH >= #{startDate} AND KI.ATTENDANCE_MONTH <= #{endDate} AND KI.USER_NAME like '%'||#{userName}||'%' AND OB.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND OB.DEPT_ID = #{deptValue} AND OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = #{pmId} AND OB.OUTSOURCE_NO = #{supplierId} AND OB.STATE = #{state} AND OB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE = #{outsourceType} AND (OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = #{pmValue} OR CE.EMPNAME = #{pmValue}) AND
ORDER BY KI.JOB_ID DESC,KR.ATTENDANCE_DATE DESC

SELECT KR.JOB_ID, KR.USER_NAME, KR.ATTENDANCE_DATE, KR.OUTSOURCE_TYPE, E4.DICTNAME OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME, KR.WORKING_TIME, KR.CLOSING_TIME, KR.WHETHER_HANDLE, KR.DATA_TYPE, CE.EMPNAME PM_NAME, CD.LOCATION DEPT_NAME, OI.OUTSOURCNAME SUPPLIER_NAME FROM ( SELECT KR1.ID, KR1.INFO_ID, KR1.JOB_ID, KR1.USER_NAME, KR1.ATTENDANCE_DATE, KR1.OUTSOURCE_TYPE, KR1.WORKING_TIME, KR1.CLOSING_TIME, KR1.AM_WHETHER_HANDLE WHETHER_HANDLE, 'AM' AS DATA_TYPE FROM PPM_KQ_RECORD KR1 WHERE KR1.AM_WHETHER_HANDLE IN ('1','2','4') UNION ALL SELECT KR2.ID, KR2.INFO_ID, KR2.JOB_ID, KR2.USER_NAME, KR2.ATTENDANCE_DATE, KR2.OUTSOURCE_TYPE, KR2.WORKING_TIME, KR2.CLOSING_TIME, KR2.PM_WHETHER_HANDLE WHETHER_HANDLE, 'PM' AS DATA_TYPE FROM PPM_KQ_RECORD KR2 WHERE KR2.PM_WHETHER_HANDLE IN ('1','2','4') ) KR LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC OB ON KR.JOB_ID = OB.JOB_ID LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE CE ON OB.PERSON_IN_CHARGE = CE.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT CD ON OB.DEPT_ID = CD.DEPID LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO OI ON OB.OUTSOURCE_NO = OI.ORGCODE LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY E4 ON KR.OUTSOURCE_TYPE = E4.DICTID AND E4.DICTTYPEID = 'BUSI_OUTSOURCE_OUTSOURCETYPE'
KR.WHETHER_HANDLE IN ('4','1') AND KR.ATTENDANCE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{attendanceDateSt},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND KR.ATTENDANCE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{attendanceDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND
ORDER BY KR.JOB_ID DESC,KR.ATTENDANCE_DATE DESC
